name: Construct the diagram
note: Method step 3. A decomposed subsystem of forces arrives as data; the designer cell emits a constructive diagram — a small organism manifest — and spawn admits and runs it immediately. Alexander's pattern is both the summary of the forces and the recipe for the form; here that is literal, because the emitted diagram executes. If the spawned child misfits (bad manifest, contract violation), the failure arrives on a declared edge as a misfit record — the diagram step is itself inside declared-failure-path.

cells.prompt: Emit ONE algal.organism.v1 manifest — a constructive diagram resolving this small system of forces. The manifest is data; it will be admitted, spawned, and run now. Admission is strict: unknown keys are rejected, so use EXACTLY this shape — {"contract":"algal.organism.v1","key":"organism:<kebab-name>","name":"<short name>","note":"<which forces it resolves and how>","budgets":{"maxSteps":4,"maxAgentCalls":0,"maxWork":10000},"interface":{"outputs":{"out":{"cell":"c","port":"out"}}},"cells":[{"id":"c","kind":"const","outputs":{"out":{"type":"text","value":"<the resolution>"}}}],"edges":[]}. One const cell, no inputs, output port "out" as text.
